about: What people want: need groups in three tiers (basic, intermediate, luxury). A group's goods substitute for each other with elasticity sigma. Utility per person is the sum over groups of weight * log(1 + Q / requirement), Q being the CES composite of the group's goods: basic needs have small requirements (quickly met), luxuries large ones (never sated). A group may also have a subsistence level (per person a tick): below it the whole of utility is scaled down by Q / subsistence, and people starve. None here: the example economy has no famines.
